subject: alebrije
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: alebrije jaguar-eagle.
Style: Oaxacan alebrije painted wood.

requests.what: Painted alebrije crown plume behind the ears: three broad carved feathers in MAGENTA, CORAL, and GOLD, with dark brown ink-like edge bands and small cream dots. Keep the plume fan readable from the front.

Rich left eagle feather fan attached to the outer wing: five overlapping pointed feathers, alternating TURQUOISE, MAGENTA, and YELLOW, with small GOLD shaft bands. Follow the existing wing silhouette and leave the teal membrane visible between feathers.

Matching right eagle feather fan: five overlapping pointed feathers, alternating TURQUOISE, MAGENTA, and YELLOW, with GOLD shaft bands. Mirror the left fan while preserving the hand-painted asymmetry of an alebrije.
Fan of three carved eagle tail feathers at the tail tip, layered upward and backward in MAGENTA, TURQUOISE, and GOLD. Add cream teardrop motifs and dark brown painted outlines.
Large left cheek rosette in CREAM, GOLD, and MAGENTA: a dark brown outer ring, six chunky petal shapes, and a turquoise centre. Seat it directly on the cheek like a carved painted medallion.
Large right cheek rosette matching the left: CREAM, GOLD, MAGENTA, and TURQUOISE with a dark brown ring. Keep both cheek ornaments bold enough to read at thumbnail size.

Decorative alebrije collar around the neck: a broad MAGENTA band with repeating GOLD diamond plates, small TURQUOISE studs, and a scalloped CREAM lower edge. Follow the neck curve without covering the face.
Central carved breast emblem on the cream bib: a turquoise jaguar sun with eight GOLD rays, a MAGENTA centre, and a dark brown outline. It should sit proud of the chest but remain flat and graphic.
Three chunky carved eagle talons on the left forepaw in CREAM with DARK_BROWN tips, splayed forward and slightly outward. Add tiny GOLD bands at their roots.
Three chunky carved eagle talons on the right forepaw in CREAM with DARK_BROWN tips, splayed forward and slightly outward. Add tiny GOLD bands at their roots.
Small hand-painted glyph on the upper beak: a dark brown zigzag bordered by CREAM, following the beak's front-facing plane. Keep the gold beak surface otherwise visible.

Paint the jaguar body as Oaxacan wood: irregular dark BROWN rosettes with CREAM centres over BODY orange, plus occasional MAGENTA and TURQUOISE accent dots. Keep the existing cream belly sector clean and graphic.
Paint a bold jaguar face mask in BODY_LIGHT, CREAM, and BROWN: forehead stripes, cheek dots, a cream muzzle transition, and tiny dark painted whisker marks. Do not obscure the eyes or beak.
Paint the left wing membrane with alternating TURQUOISE and DEEP_TEAL feather panels, thin GOLD ribs, and small MAGENTA diamond marks arranged like carved folk ornament.
Paint the right wing membrane with alternating TURQUOISE and DEEP_TEAL feather panels, thin GOLD ribs, and small MAGENTA diamond marks arranged like carved folk ornament.
Paint the tail in repeating alebrije bands of BODY orange, MAGENTA, TURQUOISE, and CREAM, with small GOLD triangles at the band boundaries and a darker BROWN underside.
